label: Finnish capital redemption contract
field.ordinaryContractConfirmed: Ordinary Finnish capital redemption contract confirmed
field.holderControlRights: Holder has control rights over underlying assets
help.scope: Use one personal contract with a Finnish insurer, verified remaining contributed principal and ordinary §35 treatment. Redemption fees and special contract tax rules require a separate calculation.
help.control: Ownership-type voting, transfer, use or trading rights can trigger §35b and remove tax deferral. Selecting from the insurer’s standard allocations is generally permitted.
help.historicalGain: Enter taxable profit already paid during the year and the remaining contributed principal separately.
help.withholding: Enter actual tax already withheld this year. New payouts with taxable profit over EUR 20 include 30% withholding.
invalid.ordinary: Confirm a standard Finnish §35 contract without holder control rights.
invalid.owner: Choose the individual who owns the contract.
invalid.distributions: Keep all investment returns inside the contract until redemption.
invalid.loss: Recognize a contract loss only when the contract closes.
invalid.quote: Use a valid withdrawal from an open capital redemption contract.
